# Cenário fedora-44-limpo: Fedora Linux 44 (Workstation Edition), usuário ana, dry-run

[INFO] [dry-run] mkdir -p /etc/dnf/libdnf5.conf.d

== remover_libreoffice (Remover LibreOffice nativo)

[OK] LibreOffice nativo removido.

== flatpaks (Flatpaks)
[INFO] Configurando Flatpak e instalando apps...
[INFO] [dry-run] flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists flathub https://flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
[INFO] [dry-run] flatpak remote-modify --enable --no-filter flathub
[INFO] [dry-run] flatpak install -y flathub com.getpostman.Postman com.github.tchx84.Flatseal com.mattjakeman.ExtensionManager com.obsproject.Studio com.spotify.Client dev.vencord.Vesktop io.dbeaver.DBeaverCommunity io.ente.auth io.github.flattool.Ignition io.github.flattool.Warehouse io.missioncenter.MissionCenter md.obsidian.Obsidian org.filezillaproject.Filezilla org.gaphor.Gaphor org.gnome.Boxes org.libreoffice.LibreOffice org.onlyoffice.desktopeditors org.qbittorrent.qBittorrent org.remmina.Remmina org.telegram.desktop org.videolan.VLC me.iepure.devtoolbox com.rtosta.zapzap be.alexandervanhee.gradia org.gnome.Snapshot org.gnome.Weather net.blip.Blip

== solaar (Solaar (Logitech))
[INFO] Instalando o Solaar pelos pacotes do Fedora...
[INFO] [dry-run] dnf install -y solaar solaar-udev
[OK] Solaar instalado pelos pacotes do Fedora.
[INFO] [dry-run] su - ana -c 'if [ -z "${DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS:-}" ] && [ -S "/run/user/$(id -u)/bus" ]; then; export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/$(id -u)"; export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bus"; fi; mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/autostart"; for desktop in /usr/share/applications/solaar.desktop \; /var/lib/flatpak/exports/share/applications/io.github.pwr_solaar.solaar.desktop; do; if [ -f "$desktop" ]; then; destino="$HOME/.config/autostart/$(basename "$desktop")"; cp "$desktop" "$destino"; sed -i -E '/^Exec=/{/ -w hide$/! s/$/ -w hide/}' "$destino"; break; fi; done'
[INFO] Configurando regras UDEV para o Solaar (regra do Solaar <solaarTag>)...
[INFO] [dry-run] escrever /etc/udev/rules.d/42-logitech-unify-permissions.rules (<regraSolaar> bytes)
[INFO] [dry-run] udevadm control --reload-rules
[INFO] [dry-run] udevadm trigger --subsystem-match=usb
[INFO] [dry-run] udevadm trigger --subsystem-match=hidraw
[OK] Regras UDEV do Solaar configuradas.

== limpeza (Limpeza final)
[INFO] Limpando o sistema...
[INFO] [dry-run] dnf autoremove -y
[INFO] [dry-run] dnf clean all
[INFO] [dry-run] rm -rf /tmp/post-install-teste
[OK] Instalação finalizada com sucesso!
[INFO] Recomenda-se reiniciar a máquina para aplicar as mudanças de grupo e kernel.
